metadata.title: Jisr | Study in Europe after the Bac
metadata.description: Find realistic Bachelor's programmes in France, Germany and the Netherlands, with costs, scholarships and application steps.

home.title: Study in Europe after the Bac
home.lead: Jisr helps you find Bachelor's programmes that are realistic for your profile, estimate the costs and prepare your application.
home.ctaNote: Your answers stay on this device.
home.questionsTitle: What Jisr helps you find out

where.title: Where can I study?
where.body: Bachelor's programmes in France, Germany and the Netherlands, sorted by what looks realistic for your profile.

apply.title: Can I apply?
apply.body: What each programme asks for, compared with your profile, and what is still left to check.

cost.title: How much will it cost?
cost.body: Tuition and living costs as ranges, shown as official figures or estimates.

next.title: What do I do next?
next.body: Deadlines, documents and steps in order, with the official link for each.

footer.privacy: Your profile stays on this device. Jisr uses no cookies.
footer.sources: Data and sources are checked by hand; every fact shows its source.

clearData.title: Clear my data?
clearData.description: This removes your profile and any unfinished answers from this device only.

status.satisfied: Published requirements appear to be met

hint.satisfied: Everything we published for this program appears to match your profile. Confirm it on the official page before you apply.
hint.check: We could not confirm everything. See what to check below, then confirm it on the official page.
hint.not_satisfied: At least one published requirement does not match your profile. Requirements can change, so check the official page.

route.direct: Based on the rules we published, your Bac appears to give direct access to a Bachelor's in this country. Confirm the current conditions on the official admission page. You still need to apply to each program separately.
route.foundation: In this country, your Bac may not give direct access to a Bachelor's. You may need a foundation year first: a preparatory year before the Bachelor's, like the German Studienkolleg. Check on the official admission page of the program or university whether it applies to you and how to get a place.
route.not_eligible: The rules we published say your Bac does not give access to a Bachelor's in this country. Rules can change, so check the official admission page.
route.check: We have not confirmed how your Bac is treated in this country. Check the official admission page.
route.missing: We have not published how your Bac is treated for this country yet: check the official admission page.
route.staleSource: The rules we published for your Bac in this country were not verified recently, so we do not state a result. Check the official admission page.
route.nonOfficialSource: The rules we published for your Bac in this country do not come from an official source, so we do not state a result. Check the official admission page.

code.ok: This requirement appears to be met.
code.below_threshold: Your value ({student}) is below the published minimum ({required}). Requirements can change, so check the official page.
code.track_not_accepted: Your Bac track ({student}) is not in the list published for this program ({required}). Check the official page in case it has changed.
code.missing_student_value: We do not have the information from you that this requirement needs. Complete your profile, then check the official source.
code.threshold_unpublished: The minimum for this requirement is not published in the sources we checked. Check it on the official admission page.
code.no_scale_conversion: We have no published way to convert your grade to the scale used here. Check on the official admission page how your grade is treated.
code.stale_source: The source for this requirement was not verified recently. Check the official page before you rely on it.
code.non_official_source: This requirement does not come from an official source. Check the official page to confirm it.
code.route_foundation: Your Bac may lead to a foundation year before the Bachelor's. Check on the official admission page what applies to you.
code.route_not_eligible: The published rules say your Bac does not give access to a Bachelor's here. Rules can change, so check the official page.
code.route_check: We have not confirmed how your Bac is treated in this country. Check the official admission page.
code.coverage_partial: We have not published all the requirements for this program. Check the official page for the rest.
code.manual_check: This requirement needs a manual check. Read it on the official source page.
code.below_threshold_converted: Your grade ({student}) converts to {studentConverted} with the published conversion table, which does not reach the published minimum ({required}). This conversion is not an official equivalence decision: check on the official admission page how your grade is treated.

documents.title: Gather your documents
documents.meaning: Collect the documents the program asks for.

translation.title: Translate documents
translation.meaning: Some documents may need a translation. Check what the program asks for.

language_exam.title: Language exam
language_exam.meaning: Take or book the language test the program accepts.

application_account.title: Create your application account
application_account.meaning: Open an account on the platform used to apply, if it asks for one.

submit.title: Submit your application
submit.meaning: Send your application before the deadline.

scholarships.title: Apply for scholarships
scholarships.meaning: Check which scholarships may suit you and their deadlines.

financial_documents.title: Show your funds
financial_documents.meaning: Prepare the documents that show how your studies are paid for.

accommodation.title: Find housing
accommodation.meaning: Look for a place to live before you arrive.

visa.title: Visa or residence permit
visa.meaning: Check the official visa rules of the destination country and apply in time.

departure.title: Prepare your departure
departure.meaning: Plan your trip and what to bring.

reason.applies: This step applies to your application.
reason.unknown_data: We do not have enough published data to know if this step applies. Check the official page.
reason.not_required_by_source: The published source does not ask for this step.
reason.certificate_held: The language certificate you hold appears to be accepted, so a new exam may not be needed. Confirm it on the official page.
reason.no_account_required: According to the published source, no application account is needed.
reason.no_scholarships_listed: We have not listed any scholarship for this program. Check the official pages for other funding.

mismatch.destination: Not in a country you chose
mismatch.field: Not in a field you chose
mismatch.institution_type: Not the type of institution you chose
mismatch.study_language: Not taught in a language you chose

cost.tenMonthNote: Monthly costs are counted for {months} months of study. Housing is often paid for 12 months, so check the rent period.
cost.missingLine: Not in the sources we reviewed, to be checked
cost.partialTotal: Partial total: some costs are not included

budgetFit.within: The estimate is within your budget.
budgetFit.straddles: Your budget falls inside the estimated range: it may or may not be enough.
budgetFit.above: The estimate is above your budget.
budgetFit.unknown: We cannot compare the estimate with your budget.

intake.closed: Closed, next dates not yet published
intake.unknown: Deadline not published, to be checked

official.label: Official
official.meaning: Published by an official source, such as a university or a public body.

estimate.label: Estimate
estimate.meaning: Our estimate from published figures. The real amount may differ.

guidance.label: General guidance
guidance.meaning: Advice to help you plan. It is not a requirement.

freshness.stale: May be outdated, check the official page
freshness.bannerAging: Some information on this page was verified a while ago. Check the official pages before you decide.
freshness.bannerStale: Some information on this page may be outdated. Check the official pages before you rely on it.

coverage.partial: We have not published all the requirements for this program. Check the official page before you rely on this.
coverage.complete: We have published all the requirements we know of for this program. The official page remains the reference.

textNote.french_fallback: Shown in French: not translated yet

rule.credential_type_in: Type of Bac asked for by the official source: {types}.
rule.credential_track_in: Bac tracks listed by the official source: {tracks}.

overall_grade_min.published: Minimum overall grade published by the official source: {required}.
overall_grade_min.unpublished: Minimum overall grade: not published, to be checked on the official page.

subject_grade_min.published: Minimum grade in {subject} published by the official source: {required}.
subject_grade_min.unpublished: Minimum grade in {subject}: not published, to be checked on the official page.

subject_taken.all: Subjects to have studied, according to the official source: {subjects}.
subject_taken.any: At least one of these subjects, according to the official source: {subjects}.

language_proficiency.published: Minimum level in {language} published by the official source: {required}.
language_proficiency.unpublished: Minimum level in {language}: not published, to be checked on the official page.
language_proficiency.certificateRequired: The official source asks for a language certificate.
language_proficiency.certificateNotRequired: The official source does not ask for a language certificate for this requirement.
language_proficiency.certificateUnpublished: Whether a language certificate is needed: not published, to be checked on the official page.
language_proficiency.certificates: Certificates listed by the official source: {certificates}.
language_proficiency.anyCertificate: The official source does not list specific certificates: a recognised certificate may count. Check the official list of certificates taken into account.

rule.prior_study_years_min: Higher education after the Bac, according to the official source: at least {count} {years, plural, one {year} other {years}}.
rule.manual_check: Another requirement from the official source: read it on the official page.
